articles.title: Consensys to split MetaMask into its own firm while staying silent on IPO
articles.snippet: The existing company, Consensys Software Inc., will rebrand as MetaMask under Ethereum co-founder Joe Lubin as chairman and CEO.

articles.title: Kalshi election data goes live on DoubleZero ahead of U.S. midterms
articles.snippet: The expansion gives institutional and automated traders access to full-depth political prediction-market order books ahead of the U.S. midterms.

articles.title: Moonshot’s Kimi rattled markets. U.S. agencies now say it was trained on American models
articles.snippet: Moonshot, whose Kimi model rattled markets earlier this year, is among six Chinese AI firms accused of systematically extracting capabilities from U.S. models.

articles.title: Bitcoin recovers toward $79,000 as Zcash records a $500 million ETF haul
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell to nearly $77,600 on Tuesday before clawing most of it back, leaving it little changed on the day while zcash gained roughly 43% on the week and Grayscale's new fund crossed half a billion dollars.

articles.title: Consensys to split into MetaMask and institutional blockchain company
articles.snippet: The restructuring will separate MetaMask’s consumer business from Consensys’ Ethereum protocols and institutional blockchain infrastructure operations.
